title: "Men's NCAA Wrestling Statistics"

## 2025 team championship standings

Compare the top 10 teams in each NCAA division. Select a division from the chart menu, or hover over a bar to see the team's points and head coach.

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

team_results <- tribble(
  ~division, ~rank, ~team, ~points, ~coach,
  "Division I", 1, "Penn State", 177, "Cael Sanderson",
  "Division I", 2, "Nebraska", 117, "Mark Manning",
  "Division I", 3, "Oklahoma State", 107.5, "David Taylor",
  "Division I", 4, "Iowa", 81, "Tom Brands",
  "Division I", 5, "Minnesota", 51.5, "Brandon Eggum",
  "Division I", 5, "Ohio State", 51.5, "Tom Ryan",
  "Division I", 7, "Cornell", 50, "Mike Grey",
  "Division I", 8, "NC State", 46.5, "Pat Popolizio",
  "Division I", 9, "Northern Iowa", 45.5, "Doug Schwab",
  "Division I", 10, "Illinois", 44.5, "Mike Poeta",
  "Division II", 1, "Nebraska-Kearney", 115, "Dalton Jensen",
  "Division II", 2, "Augustana (SD)", 63, "Jason Reitmeier",
  "Division II", 3, "St. Cloud State", 57.5, "Steve Costanzo",
  "Division II", 4, "Lander", 56, "R.C. LaHaye",
  "Division II", 5, "Central Oklahoma", 55.5, "Todd Steidley",
  "Division II", 6, "University of Mary", 51, "Adam Aho",
  "Division II", 7, "Central Missouri", 43, "Cody Garcia",
  "Division II", 8, "Kutztown", 42.5, "Not verified",
  "Division II", 9, "Maryville (MO)", 39, "Not verified",
  "Division II", 10, "West Liberty", 38.5, "Danny Irwin",
  "Division III", 1, "JWU (Providence)", 83.5, "Lonnie Morris",
  "Division III", 2, "Wartburg", 83.5, "Eric Keller",
  "Division III", 3, "Augsburg", 74, "Tony Valek",
  "Division III", 4, "Baldwin Wallace", 69, "Not verified",
  "Division III", 5, "Wisconsin-La Crosse", 65, "Dave Malecek",
  "Division III", 6, "Coe", 60, "Not verified",
  "Division III", 6, "North Central (IL)", 60, "Not verified",
  "Division III", 8, "Alvernia", 58, "Kriss Bellanca",
  "Division III", 9, "Coast Guard", 40.5, "Kevin A. Bratland",
  "Division III", 9, "Wisconsin-Eau Claire", 40.5, "Not verified"
)

divisions <- unique(team_results$division)
chart <- plot_ly()

for (division in divisions) {
  division_data <- team_results |>
    filter(.data$division == division) |>
    mutate(team_label = paste(rank, team))

  chart <- chart |>
    add_trace(
      data = division_data,
      x = ~points,
      y = ~team_label,
      text = ~coach,
      type = "bar",
      orientation = "h",
      name = division,
      visible = division == "Division I",
      hovertemplate = paste(
        "<b>%{y}</b><br>",
        "Championship points: %{x}<br>",
        "Head coach: %{text}",
        "<extra></extra>"
      )
    )
}

division_buttons <- map(divisions, \(division) {
  list(
    method = "update",
    label = division,
    args = list(
      list(visible = divisions == division),
      list(title = list(text = paste("2025 NCAA", division, "team points")))
    )
  )
})

chart |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "2025 NCAA Division I team points"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Championship points", rangemode = "tozero"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed"),
    updatemenus = list(list(
      type = "dropdown",
      buttons = division_buttons,
      x = 1,
      xanchor = "right",
      y = 1.15
    )),
    height = 600
  )
```

## Standings

The table keeps the division rankings and coach names together for easy comparison. Coaches marked **Not verified** could not be confirmed in an accessible 2024–25 source.

```{r}
#| echo: false
team_results |>
  arrange(factor(division, levels = divisions), rank, team) |>
  select(Division = division, Rank = rank, Team = team, Points = points, Coach = coach) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "2025 NCAA men's wrestling championship team standings")
```

## Sources

Team rankings and championship points are from the NCAA records:

- [Division I records (D1.pdf)](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D1.pdf)
- [Division II records (D2.pdf)](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D2.pdf)
- [Division III records (D3.pdf)](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D3.pdf)

Coach names are shown for the 2024–25 championship season where verified. Unverified names are marked **Not verified** rather than guessed.
